changes.title: Proposal: registered extension for physical-validity verification (Agent Card capability declaration)
changes.text:
Strong proposal — the verdict model (PASS/FLAG/VETO) plus audit-log availability gives counterparties something concrete to require, not just a self-declared capability flag.

One structural question worth baking into the schema from day one: when a counterparty filters for `physics-validation/v1`, they're trusting that the declaring agent actually ran the versioned rule table against that specific action — nothing in the extension today lets a third party confirm that independently of the declaring agent's own audit log.
